name: Post-Training Alignment
question: Why does a freshly pretrained model answer a question with another question?
problem: A base model learned to continue internet text. Ask it a question and it treats it like a quiz sheet and writes more questions.
points: Supervised fine-tuning wraps conversations in a chat template and computes loss only on the assistant's reply.
Preference alignment (RLHF or DPO) teaches judgment by rewarding the preferred of two answers.
Pretraining gives the model its knowledge. Post-training gives it the assistant's format and judgment.
title: Why $50M Base Models Fail: SFT and RLHF Explained #shorts
